title: ooRexx interpreter bugs found by rx2cpp, and checking trunk first
summary: Compiling real code exercises the native API harder than most users, and has found interpreter bugs. Status against trunk r13284 (2026-10-23): ReleaseGlobalReference adding a reference instead of removing one, fixed in r13257 (#2100); the uninit count bug (BUG_REPORTS.md bug 5), fixed in r13259 (#2102) before we found it; the SysStemSort crash, fixed in r13284 (#2120); the per-call /proc/self/maps read, fixed in r13267 (#2106). Still present in trunk a4210fc and ready to file (Tom Dyer files; TICKET_bug2.md, patch ooRexx-native-arg-error.patch): an argument error from processArguments of a native method called by native code leaves a NativeActivation with argList pointing at an unwound C stack; CheckCondition() answers false and the next garbage collection can crash. On a trunk build: unpatched segfault 3/3, patched no crash and CheckCondition=1 3/3. Likely cause of BSF4ooRexx crashes under object-creation pressure. Reproductions and patches: ootest/interpreter_bugs/.
procedure: Reproduce with a minimal program and a control.
Check ooRexx trunk (GitHub mirror ooRexx/oorexx: commits and the bug tracker) for a fix before writing anything.
Build trunk from the GitHub mirror (cmake, Release) and run the reproduction unpatched and patched on it; record both results in the ticket.
If not fixed, write the ticket with the reproduction and a patch; Tom Dyer files it.
invariants: Our test interpreter is r13196; trunk moves. A ticket written without checking trunk was stale once (bug 5) and must not happen again.
rx2cpp must be correct with or without an upstream fix (for example it no longer depends on global references for values).

provenance.claim: Bug 2 ticket checked against trunk a4210fc, verified on a trunk build.
Status of every bug against trunk.
